assertions.expression: (() => { if (innerWidth < 1440) return true; const c = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('main [data-hero-actions] > a')).map((a) => { const r = a.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.top + r.height / 2; }); return Math.max(...c) - Math.min(...c) <= 1; })()
(() => { const s = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('main [data-hero-actions] > a')).map((a) => parseFloat(getComputedStyle(a).fontSize)); return s.every((v) => v === s[0]) && s[0] >= 14; })()

(() => { const accent = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--color-accent').trim(); const probe = document.createElement('div'); probe.style.color = accent; document.body.appendChild(probe); const rgb = getComputedStyle(probe).color; probe.remove(); return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('main [data-hero-actions] > a')).filter((a) => getComputedStyle(a).backgroundColor === rgb).map((a) => a.textContent.trim()).join('|'); })()

(() => { const a = document.querySelector("header a[aria-label='Data With Dillon, home']"); const s = getComputedStyle(a); return [a.getAttribute('href'), s.textTransform, s.fontSize, s.fontWeight, s.letterSpacing].join('|'); })()

(() => { const a = document.querySelector("header a[aria-label='Data With Dillon, home']"); const sp = a.querySelector('span'); return [sp.textContent, getComputedStyle(sp).color, getComputedStyle(a).color].join('|'); })()

(() => { return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("header nav a")).every((a) => { const s = getComputedStyle(a); return s.fontSize === '14px' && s.fontWeight === '500' && s.textTransform === 'none'; }); })()
